conventions.trace: w=sqrt(v)*u with v=N/P. The axial current is integral w_dagger*sigma_z*w drho. Radial profiles use Lebesgue drho, with upper real and lower i times real.
conventions.spaces: A has exact zero then n upper massive components; B has n lower massive components. Y is n by(n+1). No second artificial zero channel is inserted.
conventions.massive_mode_phases: Each lower Ritz vector has its largest-magnitude Laguerre coefficient positive; its upper partner is (partial_rho+W_Melvin)f_minus/lambda. This fixes phases before comparing different cutoffs.
conventions.opposite_end: At the reflected negative-z end, the opposite graph is Zminus(z)=Zplus(-z)^T in these paired real phases. This Weyl has one physical incoming upper zero channel there and no outgoing zero channel. The rectangular zero row may mix with massive columns; it is not an extra channel.
conventions.gauge: Use actual project Aphysical=-q*Ahat/(2Q), regular outer-axis Aphysical=0; no removal of asymptotic flux without shifting mu.
conventions.units: D=1 Weyl coordinate separation, kappa and masses inverse D. z is Weyl axial coordinate, not proper distance.

scope: A fixed finite-channel axial projection of the actual curved dihole at |z|>=4; not a full meridional PDE, mouth map, throat sewing or quantum-source calculation.
Finite-L pure Melvin initial data omit the actual exterior beyond L. L refinement measures numerical sensitivity only; it is not a rigorous tail enclosure or proof of the infinite-domain map.
One leading1/L corrected start includes the fixed-basis dilation mixing through the projected coefficients. Its remaining far-tail error is not certified.
Radial Ritz residuals, quadrature, paired-basis and ODE controls are floating-point tests. Omitted massive channels and other azimuthal sectors remain uncontrolled.
This helper caps its exp-weight Laguerre quadrature at144 nodes; larger orders require a different stable weight evaluation and are explicitly rejected.
The chiral zero mode is exact in the Melvin limit. Curved finite-z projections can mix it with retained massive channels.
The background retains its classical horizons and Melvin environment. No supporting quantum state, stability, traversability or time travel is established.
